tagline: Preserving Freshness, Delivering Excellence Across Nigeria

sections.name: Hero
sections.copy: Food Affair Cold Chain Limited: Your Trusted Partner in Temperature-Controlled Logistics. From farm to table, we ensure your perishable goods arrive fresh, safe, and on time across Nigeria. State-of-the-art cold chain solutions for restaurants, food producers, and distributors.

sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Food Affair Cold Chain Limited (also operating as Food Affair Logistics Co) is Nigeria's premier foodtech logistics company specializing in temperature-controlled transportation and storage solutions. Based in Abuja, we understand the critical importance of maintaining the cold chain for perishable goods in Nigeria's dynamic food industry. Our CEO, a seasoned ghost kitchen operator, founded Food Affair with a deep understanding of the challenges faced by food businesses in preserving product quality during transit. We leverage cutting-edge refrigeration technology, GPS-tracked vehicles, and trained logistics professionals to bridge the gap between food producers and consumers. Whether you're a restaurant chain, food manufacturer, pharmaceutical company, or agricultural exporter, we guarantee your products maintain optimal temperature from pickup to delivery across the FCT and beyond.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Cold Chain Transportation: Temperature-controlled delivery of perishables across Abuja and Nigeria with real-time monitoring.

Cold Storage Solutions: Secure, hygienic warehouse facilities for short and long-term storage of frozen and chilled goods.

Last-Mile Delivery: Reliable cold chain delivery directly to restaurants, retailers, and end consumers.

Pharmaceutical Logistics: Specialized handling of temperature-sensitive medications and vaccines.

Ghost Kitchen Supplies: Dedicated logistics support for cloud kitchens and virtual restaurants.

Bulk Distribution: Efficient cold chain management for large-scale food manufacturers and importers.

Temperature Monitoring: 24/7 IoT-enabled tracking ensuring compliance with food safety standards.
